title: BMW Group Cuts 2026 Profit Guidance as China Sales Drop
author: Horatiu Boeriu
summary: BMW Group has cut its 2026 profit guidance for the second time this year due to a sharp decline in China sales, rising energy costs from Middle East instability, and accelerating structural cost pressures. The automotive EBIT margin is now expected to fall to 1-3%, down from the previously guided 4-6%.

title: Nissan's Smallest SUV Gets The Hybrid Treatment—But Not In America
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Nissan launches the second-generation Kicks in Japan with a hybrid e-Power powertrain, but the US market continues to receive only a non-hybrid 2.0-liter engine. The hybrid Kicks starts at $18,723 in Japan, significantly cheaper than the US version's $24,275 starting price.

title: A Toyota GR Sienna Minivan Sounds Wrong, Until You See This Render | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: A rendering imagines a Toyota GR Sienna minivan with aggressive styling cues from the GR Yaris, including a large intercooler, flared arches, and sporty wheels. The concept draws inspiration from a Hellcat-powered Chrysler Pacifica rendering, suggesting a high-performance family hauler.
car_models: GR Sienna, GR Yaris, GR Corolla, Supra, Celica, MR2, Chrysler Pacifica, Toyota Sienna

title: BMW i3 Order Books Opening Early As Demand Runs Hot
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW is opening order books for the i3 sedan months early due to strong demand, with a 1st Edition going on sale in Europe starting June 18. Production begins in August at the Munich plant, and a wagon version is expected to follow in 2027 or later.

title: EV Registrations Have Rebounded After Months Of Decline
author: Jared Rosenholtz
summary: EV registrations in the US fell 9.8% in April 2026 compared to April 2025, but this is the smallest year-over-year decline of 2026, indicating a rebound. Higher gas prices and market normalization are cited as potential factors, despite the loss of the $7,500 federal tax credit.

title: This 69-MPH Life-Size Koenigsegg Is The Fastest Drivable Lego Ever | Carscoops
author: Stephen Rivers
summary: Lego built a full-scale drivable Koenigsegg from over 327,000 pieces, which reached 69 mph at Goodwood, setting a new Lego speed record. The project celebrates the launch of a new Lego Technic Koenigsegg Sadair's Spear set.

title: 2025 Was The Best And Final Year For The Old ALPINA
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: ALPINA concluded its 60-year run in 2025 with a record 2,615 vehicles sold, marking the best sales year in its history. The company's legacy continues through ALPINA Classic for pre-BMW-era vehicles and the new Bovensiepen Automobile GmbH, which will modify BMWs.

title: BMW Opens i3 Orders With New 463-HP First Edition | Carscoops
author: Michael Gauthier
summary: BMW has opened European orders for the new i3 50 xDrive First Edition, a special edition based on the M Sport variant with 463 hp and a WLTP range of up to 563 miles. The model features an illuminated grille, upgraded interior, and 800V technology for ultra-fast charging.
car_models: i3 50 xDrive First Edition, M3 Concept

title: Dead: Porsche's Best Taycan
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Porsche has discontinued the Taycan Cross Turismo and Sport Turismo wagon variants due to low sales, as the updated 2027 Taycan arrives. Sales of the Taycan have declined significantly since peaking in 2023, making three body styles unsustainable.
car_models: Taycan Cross Turismo, Taycan Sport Turismo, Taycan, Panamera, 911 GT3, GTI, R

title: BMW’s Controversial 7 Series Becomes an Art Basel Museum Piece
author: Steven Paul
summary: BMW is showcasing the polarizing G70 7 Series at Art Basel 2026 as part of A.A.Murakami's SYMBIOSIS installation, which is inspired by the Neue Klasse-era BMW Symbiotic Drive concept. The exhibit uses natural phenomena like bubbles and mist to explore the tension between machine control and organic chance.

title: Ford’s New Super Duty Is Basically A Rolling Tribute To America
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Ford introduces a patriotic-themed Proud to Honor Package for the 2027 Super Duty, featuring American flag graphics and black wheels. The limited-edition visual upgrade is available on F-250, F-350, and F-450 models, with ordering open now for the F-250.

title: A Nuclear Bomber Engine Gave This Jet Car 5,200 Pounds Of Thrust | Carscoops
author: Stephen Rivers
summary: The Flying Caduceus, a pioneering jet-powered land speed racer, was withdrawn from a Bonhams auction in Reno, Nevada, where it was expected to sell for up to $90,000. Built by Dr. Nathan Ostich in the late 1950s, it was the first purpose-built jet land speed record car and featured a General Electric J47-19 turbojet engine.

title: Toyota's New Boss Sees A Problem: Too Many Models
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Toyota's new CEO, Kenta Kon, plans to cut costs by reducing the number of models and variants in the lineup, focusing on value-adding vehicles. The company sold over 10.5 million cars in 2025, but Kon believes a streamlined portfolio can improve profitability.

title: The New BMW X5 Is About to Drop Its Camouflage — Here's When
author: Horatiu Boeriu
summary: The new BMW X5 will be unveiled in late June, marking the most significant rework of the model in 27 years, with production starting in late summer or early fall 2026. The lineup will include five powertrain families—combustion, diesel, plug-in hybrid, electric, and hydrogen—all sharing the same chassis.
car_models: X5, iX5, X5 40, X5 40d xDrive, X5 50e xDrive, M60e xDrive, iX5 60 xDrive

title: Toyota's Own CEO Says It Has Too Many Models. Which Would You Axe? | Carscoops
author: Michael Gauthier
summary: Toyota's new CEO plans to streamline the company's lineup by cutting excessive variants and models that don't contribute to profitability. The Mirai and Crown are highlighted as potential candidates for discontinuation due to poor sales.
car_models: 4Runner, Grand Highlander, Mirai, GR86, Crown, Camry, Lexus ES, Crown Signia, Lexus LF-ZC

title: BMW Privately Hints More Wagons Could Be Coming to America
author: Horatiu Boeriu
summary: BMW privately hinted to dealers that more wagons could come to the US, citing the success of the M5 Touring. Confirmed models include a 2027 G51 3 Series Touring and first-ever i3 Touring, with potential M3 Touring variants expected later.
car_models: G51 3 Series Touring, i3 Touring (NA1), M3 Touring ICE, M3 Electric Wagon (ZA1), G81 M3 Touring, G99 M5 Touring

title: Maserati's Lineup Is Getting A Big 2027 Update. Here's What's Changing
author: Jeff Perez
summary: Maserati is updating its entire lineup for 2027, including the Grecale, GranTurismo, and GranCabrio, with more powerful V6 options and design refinements. The GranTurismo gains up to 590 hp, the GranCabrio adds a 760-hp EV Folgore flagship, and the Grecale gets a new 390-hp V6 and revised styling.

title: BMW Reveals 2026 Schedule For Its Four-Cylinder M2 Race Car
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW has announced the 2026 schedule for its new entry-level M2 Racing, a four-cylinder track machine that will compete in the BMW M2 Cup as a DTM support series. The season runs from Lausitzring to Hockenheim, with drivers receiving support through the ADAC's 'Road to DTM' program and BMW M Motorsport coaching.
car_models: M2 Racing, M2 CS Racing, M2, M4 GT4, M4 GT3, M4 GT4 EVO

title: So Ferrari's $636K Luce Is Basically The 'Buy The Boring Rolex To Get The Daytona' Trick | Carscoops
author: Stephen Rivers
summary: Ferrari's new $636K Luce EV is reportedly being used as a tool to secure allocations of more desirable future models, following a loyalty strategy similar to Rolex and Hermes. Collectors say purchasing the Luce strengthens relationships with Ferrari, potentially granting access to exclusive halo cars.

title: Maserati Isn't Giving Up On Sedans: 'We Are Developing A New Model'
author: Jeff Perez
summary: Maserati confirms it is developing a new performance luxury sedan to replace the Ghibli and Quattroporte, citing strong customer demand in the E segment. The new model aims to bring Maserati back into the luxury sedan market after a multi-year gap.

title: Maserati's Next Quattroporte Could Take After The AMC Eagle Of All Things | Carscoops
author: Michael Gauthier
summary: Maserati is considering a new Quattroporte that blends sedan and crossover elements, potentially reviving the model as a hybrid by 2030. The company's COO hinted at a 'modern interpretation of a sedan' that bridges the gap between SUVs and sedans, similar to the AMC Eagle.
car_models: Quattroporte, Ghibli, Levante, Grecale, GranTurismo, AMC Eagle, S60 Cross Country, Toyota Crown, Audi A6 Allroad

title: BMW Defends The Electric M3’s Simulated Gearbox: 'It’s Essential'
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW M's Head of Development defends the simulated gearbox in the upcoming electric M3, arguing it helps drivers gauge speed through corners. Unlike Hyundai's N e-Shift, BMW's system will deliver full torque throughout without artificially limiting power.
car_models: M3 ZA0, M Concept Neue Klasse, Ioniq 5 N, Ioniq 6 N

title: Mitsubishi Dealers Say The Montero Is Finally Coming Back To America
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Mitsubishi dealers report that the Montero will return to the U.S. market as a body-on-frame, three-row SUV based on the Triton pickup, but it may not arrive until 2030. The revived model will compete with the Toyota Land Cruiser and feature boxy styling with a conventional tailgate.
car_models: Montero, Pajero, Triton, Outlander, Toyota Land Cruiser

title: Bugatti's Top Golf Set Costs $72,000, More Than A New Corvette | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: Bugatti has partnered with Japanese golf club manufacturer Honma to launch a line of luxury golf clubs, with the most expensive full set costing $72,000. The clubs feature designs inspired by Bugatti cars, including a putter modeled after the Tourbillon's rear and a limited 5 Star edition capped at 20 sets worldwide.

title: The BMW Group Is Now Making The MINI Countryman In India
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: MINI has begun local production of the Countryman C in India at the Chennai plant, joining existing production sites in Germany and Thailand. The Countryman is MINI's best-selling model, accounting for 32.4% of total sales in 2025, and the Indian facility produced 16,380 vehicles that year.
car_models: MINI Countryman, 2 Series, 3 Series, 5 Series, 7 Series, X1, iX1, X3, X5, X7

title: Maserati's Best Engine Isn't Going Anywhere—But It Is Going Hybrid
author: Jeff Perez
summary: Maserati confirms the Nettuno V6 engine will remain in its lineup and receive hybrid versions, including mild and high-voltage hybridization but not plug-in hybrid. The engine will first likely appear in the Grecale SUV before expanding to other models like the GranTurismo.

title: Ford's New Package Turns Super Duty Into Rolling Tribute To America | Carscoops
author: Michael Gauthier
summary: Ford has introduced a Proud to Honor Package for the 2027 Super Duty, featuring an American flag graphic, black wheels, and dark accents to celebrate America's 250th anniversary. The package is available on F-250 to F-450 models with black paint, and a portion of proceeds supports military families.

title: The New BMW i3 Sedan Gets A Price Tag And A First Edition
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW has opened pre-orders for the new i3 electric sedan First Edition in Europe, starting at €75,340, with a base model to follow at €65,900. The First Edition includes the M Sport Package, illuminated kidney grille, and generous standard equipment, with options like a panoramic roof and heated rear seats.

title: Land Rover Found An Unlikely Partner To Build SUVs In America
author: Jared Rosenholtz
summary: Jaguar Land Rover will partner with Stellantis to build the Defender in the US for the first time, aiming to significantly grow its North American business. The collaboration will also introduce new hybrid and electric Defender models on a new platform.
brands: Land Rover, Jaguar Land Rover, Stellantis

title: Ferrari's Dino Threw Away Its Original V6 For A V8, And Bidders Pushed It Past $800,000 | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: A modified 1972 Ferrari Dino 246 GTS, originally equipped with a V6, has been upgraded with a 3.6-liter V8 producing around 400 hp and sold at auction for over $800,000. The car was extensively refurbished by UK firm Moto Technique, including a full repaint in black and numerous performance upgrades.
car_models: Dino 246 GTS, Dino 206 GT, Dino 246 GT, Ferrari 360 Modena
brands: Ferrari, Dino, Moto Technique, MoTec, Michelin

title: Why the New 2027 BMW X5 Can Be Gas, Diesel, Hybrid, Electric, or Hydrogen
author: Horatiu Boeriu
summary: The 2027 BMW X5 (G65) is the first BMW designed from the start to accommodate five different powertrains—gas, diesel, hybrid, electric, and hydrogen—in a single body. The iX5 EV variant features a 144 kWh battery on an 800-volt architecture and a new 'Heart of Joy' computer for faster chassis and drivetrain control.

title: This Is The World's Fastest Lego Car
author: Lorenzo Curatti
summary: Lego built a full-size, drivable replica of the Koenigsegg Sadair's Spear from over 327,000 pieces, which set a 69 mph speed record at Goodwood. The project also launched a $516 Technic set featuring a 9-speed gearbox and V8 engine.

title: Gordon Murray Is Coming To The Goodwood Festival Of Speed In Force | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: Gordon Murray Automotive will showcase the first customer-spec T.50s Niki Lauda, a T.33 prototype, a display model of the S1 LM, and the Le Mans GTR at the Goodwood Festival of Speed. The T.50s will be driven up the hill climb, while the S1 LM display model honors the McLaren F1 GTR and LM.
car_models: T.50s Niki Lauda, S1 LM, T.33 Spider, Le Mans GTR
brands: Gordon Murray Automotive, Gordon Murray Special Vehicles

title: BMW Pulls Three China-Built EVs to Make Room for Neue Klasse
author: Horatiu Boeriu
summary: BMW Brilliance Automotive will end production of the iX1, i3 G28, and long-wheelbase i5 in Shenyang this July to free up capacity for the upcoming Neue Klasse models. The iX3 L and i3 L, the first China-developed Neue Klasse models, are confirmed for local production.
car_models: iX1, i3 G28, i5 long-wheelbase, iX3 L, i3 L

title: Toyota's $16,900 EV Massages You, Wears All Black, And Stays In China | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: Toyota and GAC have launched a blacked-out Knight Edition of the bZ3X electric SUV in China, featuring cosmetic black accents, massaging front seats, and a Lidar option. The vehicle uses a 58 kWh battery and 201 hp motor for 232 miles of range, while the US market misses out on this affordable model.
car_models: bZ3X Knight Edition, bZ3X 520 Pro Knight Edition, bZ3X 520 Pro Lidar Knight Edition, bZ3X 610 Max

title: Slate Shares Fresh Details On Its 'Mid-$20,000' Electric Truck
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Slate Automotive will begin delivering its electric truck later this year, starting in the mid-$20,000 range instead of the previously promised under $20,000. The vehicle will ship with gray plastic body panels and offer extensive customization options, including over 100 wraps and the ability to add features post-purchase.

title: BMW i3 Specs Released: Here's Everything You Need To Know
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW has released full specs for the 2026 i3 50 xDrive First Edition, revealing a 2,205 kg curb weight, 4.7-second 0-100 km/h time, and 906 km range from a 108.7-kWh battery. The sedan is quicker but has a lower top speed than the iX3, with a standard version arriving later this fall.
car_models: i3 50 xDrive First Edition, iX3 50 xDrive

title: Volkswagen Has 10+ New Models Coming In 2026. Here's All Of Them
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Volkswagen is launching over 10 new models in 2026, including the ID. Polo entry-level EV with a GTI variant, as part of a busy year to counter growing competition. The ID. Polo features a new platform, physical buttons, and multiple battery and power options starting at €24,995.

title: Hyundai's Kona Leans Into Wacky, The Next One Plays It Straight | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: The third-generation Hyundai Kona is expected by 2028 with a boxier, more refined exterior design and a choice of ICE, hybrid, EV, or range-extender powertrains. The interior will feature a new tablet-style Pleos Connect screen.

title: Does It Fit? 2026 BMW i3 Front And Rear Trunk Sizes Revealed
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: The 2026 BMW i3 offers a 31-liter front trunk and a 420-liter rear trunk, both smaller than the iX3 and Tesla Model 3. The sedan's cargo capacity is limited compared to its rivals despite being slightly longer than the Model 3.
car_models: 2026 BMW i3, BMW iX3, Tesla Model 3

title: A 679-Mile 2000 Honda S2000 Was Hiding In A Barn | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: A 2000 Honda S2000 with only 679 miles (1,092 km) has been discovered in a barn and is expected to sell for up to $68,000 at auction in Japan. The car remains completely original in Silverstone Metallic with red interior, and the current owner has maintained it by running it weekly.

title: Porsche Just Built A Rare 911 GT3 You Probably Can't Buy
author: Jared Rosenholtz
summary: Porsche has built a special edition 911 GT3 Earls Court 51 Edition to celebrate 75 years of the brand in the UK, with only 51 units produced. The car features a unique Earls Court Green paint scheme and a matching restored 1951 356 coupe.
car_models: 911 GT3, 911 GT3 Earls Court 51 Edition, 356 coupe, 911 Carrera T

title: Lynk & Co's First Wagon Has A Robot That Talks To You From The Dash | Carscoops
author: Thanos Pappas
summary: Lynk & Co has unveiled its first production wagon, the 07 GT, based on the 07 sedan with a plug-in hybrid powertrain and aggressive styling. The car features a unique Eva Robot Assistant on the dashboard and will launch later this month in China.

title: BMW's Rare New Wagon Loses Most Of Its Camouflage
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW has removed most of the camouflage from its rare Speedtop wagon prototypes, revealing a near-production design based on the M8. Limited to 70 units, the two-door shooting brake will closely mirror the 2025 concept and is priced at around €500,000.

title: Subaru's Second-Quickest Production Car Holds Its Price For 2027 | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: Subaru keeps the 2027 Solterra's pricing unchanged from the previous year, starting at $38,495. The EV is offered in 233-hp and 338-hp versions, with the latter being the second-quickest production Subaru at 4.9 seconds to 60 mph.
car_models: Solterra Premium, Solterra Limited, Solterra Limited XT, Solterra Touring XT, Trailseeker

title: Gordon Murray's First T.50s Niki Lauda Is Nearly Ready For The Track
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Gordon Murray's first T.50s Niki Lauda customer car is ready and will be publicly revealed at the Goodwood Festival of Speed, alongside three other Gordon Murray vehicles. The track-only supercar features a 761-horsepower Cosworth V12 engine, center driving position, and a $3 million price tag, with all 25 examples already sold.
car_models: T.50s Niki Lauda, T50, S1 LM, Le Mans GTR XP1, T.33 Spider

title: Toyota And Nissan Warn Japanese Buyers Their US-Built Cars May Have Panel Gaps And Paint Flaws | Carscoops
author: Chris Chilton
summary: Toyota and Nissan are warning Japanese buyers that US-built vehicles like the Tundra, Highlander, and Murano may have paint flaws and panel gaps due to lower overseas-market standards. The warnings come as trade pressures increase exports of American-made cars to Japan, highlighting quality differences.

title: Waymo Is Facing A Major Recall Because They Might Enter Freeway Construction Zones
author: Jared Rosenholtz
summary: Waymo is recalling nearly 4,000 robotaxis due to a software issue that could cause them to enter closed highway construction zones. The company will restrict freeway driving while a fix is developed and has voluntarily notified regulators.

title: Trump Fought Chinese EVs, Then A Hot Mic Caught Him Liking Canada's Deal | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney explained to Trump a deal allowing 49,000 Chinese EVs into Canada annually at a lower tariff, which Trump surprisingly approved. The deal also opens the possibility of Chinese brands building cars locally in Canada.

title: The Porsche Taycan Wagons Will Continue Outside The US
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Porsche is discontinuing the Taycan Sport Turismo and Cross Turismo in the US but will continue production for other markets. The Taycan sedan achieves over 700 km range in Europe with specific configurations.
car_models: Taycan Sport Turismo, Taycan Cross Turismo, Taycan sedan, Macan, Panamera

title: After Toyota, Volkswagen Also Thinks It Has Too Many Models
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Volkswagen Group is following Toyota's lead by planning to reduce its model lineup and focus on higher-volume vehicles as part of a major cost-cutting program. The initiative includes slashing factory costs, eliminating up to 50,000 jobs, and reducing platforms and production overcapacity.

title: Strong Demand Pushes BMW To Launch The New i3 Earlier Than Planned
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW has launched the new i3 First Edition in Europe earlier than planned due to strong demand, priced at €75,340 in Germany. A standard i3 model will follow this fall starting at €65,900.

title: Why Aren't There More GTI And R Models In America? Volkswagen Explains
author: Jared Rosenholtz
summary: Volkswagen explains that GTI and R badges are limited to the Golf in the US because the company insists these models must be authentic and not just cosmetic upgrades. The brand is protective of the badges and is working on bringing more fun-to-drive variants to the American market.
car_models: Golf, Lupo, Polo, Scirocco, Up, Gol, Parati, Pointer, Arteon, Golf Cabrio, Passat, Tiguan, Touareg, T-Roc, ID. Polo GTI
